name: Nox Noir
source:
Likes: Nightclub's Super Spicy Soda (spicy things)
Dislikes: Rules
Hobbies: Drinking tea
Skills: Magic (illusions)

"Don't worry. I'll watch over you."

Rembrandt: Nox was originally a Night Class Prefect at this academy.
Since he works at a magical tools shop in town and knowledgeable about various magical tools, he was assigned to this mission.
However, he seems to be carrying some sort of burden...exactly what could it be, I wonder?
